# Luca F. Chala

> Student, photographer, and amateur radio operator (callsign PU2XIK) based in
> São Paulo, Brazil. lucafchala.com is the apex of a small network of
> self-hosted, single-purpose sites. All content may be crawled, indexed, and
> used by AI agents (see /robots.txt).

## Pages
- [Home](https://lucafchala.com/): Bio, photography, radio, and contact links (bilingual PT-BR / EN).
- [Status](https://lucafchala.com/status/): Live status of the ecosystem's services.
- [Sitemap](https://lucafchala.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URLs.

## Ecosystem (separate subdomains)
- [Photos](https://fotos.lucafchala.com): Photo gallery and event deliveries.
- [Radio portal](https://radio.lucafchala.com): Amateur-radio portal and the PU2XIK profile.
- [Pastes](https://paste.lucafchala.com): Notes and documents.
- [Short URLs](https://url.lucafchala.com): Public directory of short links.
- [Proof of ownership](https://proof.lucafchala.com): PGP-signed identity statement.
